name: Porch
description: A covered porch with a bench by your front door.

name: Garden
description: A fenced flower and vegetable patch behind your house.

name: Basement
description: A room under your house, with a ladder down.

name: Second floor
description: A full upstairs room with windows and a ladder.

name: Stable
description: A stable beside your house, with hay and a water trough.

name: Pool
description: A small pool in your garden.

name: Lookout tower
description: A tall tower on your roof with a view.

name: Bigger plot
description: Your business plot grows to 24 by 24.

name: Biggest plot
description: Your business plot grows to 32 by 32.

name: Cat
description: A tame cat that follows you home.

name: Wolf
description: A tame wolf that follows you.

name: Parrot
description: A tame parrot that rides on your shoulder.

name: Name colour
description: Your name in a colour you pick. Changing it later costs $10.

name: Shop banner
description: A banner to design on the loom, and a glowing OPEN sign.

name: Fireworks show
description: Fireworks over your house. Used up when it goes off.

name: Advert
description: 2 extra townsfolk visits to your shops today.

name: Herald ad
description: One line about your shop in tomorrow's morning news.
